description: Phase 6aq gate — NATURAL JOIN and JOIN ... USING (col-list). Both desugar to JOIN ON.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t1 (id INTEGER, name TEXT);
CREATE TABLE t2 (id INTEGER, score INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t1 VALUES (1, 'a'), (2, 'b');
INSERT INTO t2 VALUES (1, 100), (2, 200);
SELECT id, name, score FROM t1 NATURAL JOIN t2 ORDER BY id;
CREATE TABLE t1 (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, c INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE t2 (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, d INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t1 VALUES (1, 10, 100), (2, 20, 200);
INSERT INTO t2 VALUES (1, 10, 999), (2, 99, 888);
SELECT a, b, c, d FROM t1 NATURAL JOIN t2 ORDER BY a;

cases.name: natural-join-no-shared-columns
cases.description: NATURAL JOIN of tables with no shared column names is a cross product (SQLite behavior).

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t1 (a INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE t2 (b INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t1 VALUES (1), (2);
INSERT INTO t2 VALUES (10), (20);
SELECT a, b FROM t1 NATURAL JOIN t2 ORDER BY a, b;
CREATE TABLE t1 (id INTEGER, name TEXT);
CREATE TABLE t2 (id INTEGER, score INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t1 VALUES (1, 'a'), (2, 'b'), (3, 'c');
INSERT INTO t2 VALUES (1, 100), (2, 200);
SELECT id, name, score FROM t1 JOIN t2 USING (id) ORDER BY id;
CREATE TABLE t1 (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, v INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE t2 (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, w INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t1 VALUES (1, 2, 100), (3, 4, 200);
INSERT INTO t2 VALUES (1, 2, 999), (3, 5, 888);
SELECT a, b, v, w FROM t1 JOIN t2 USING (a, b);
CREATE TABLE t1 (id INTEGER, name TEXT);
CREATE TABLE t2 (id INTEGER, score INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t1 VALUES (1, 'a'), (2, 'b'), (3, 'c');
INSERT INTO t2 VALUES (1, 100), (2, 200);
SELECT id, name, score FROM t1 NATURAL LEFT JOIN t2 ORDER BY id;
CREATE TABLE t1 (id INTEGER, v INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE t2 (id INTEGER, w INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t1 VALUES (1, 10), (2, 20), (3, 30);
INSERT INTO t2 VALUES (1, 100), (3, 300);
SELECT id, v, w FROM t1 LEFT JOIN t2 USING (id) ORDER BY id;

CREATE TABLE t2 (b INTEGER);
